warnings.why: The reported value of 3.81 is likely an underestimate reflecting only formal sector employment, failing to account for the significant role of women in agriculture and informal home-based work, despite severe restrictions.

The value of 74.9 is highly suspect as the country does not provide reliable, transparent labor market data to international organizations, and this figure likely reflects state-mandated labor participation rather than standard economic employment metrics.

policy: model memory is advisory; unsupported suspicions cannot overrule official data
